title: Flow-control stratification for KV cache and GPU memory under sustained high QPS
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Under sustained high QPS we observe correlated KV cache thrashing and GPU memory pressure that cause microbatch collapse and large p99 tail latency spikes. This ticket designs and implements a "pressure stratification" flow-control layer that (1) separates admission signals into short-term burst pressure vs sustained pressure, (2) applies different backpressure policies based on KV occupancy percentiles and GPU reserved headroom, and (3) exposes tunables to balance throughput vs tail latency per-customer.
comments: 2025-02-20 - Aisha Kumar: Created ticket after incident postmortem. Root cause hypothesis: naive single-threshold admission leads to oscillation when KV eviction and GPU allocation interact. Proposed approach: dual-path admission (burst vs sustained) + percentile-aware KV headroom metric.

2025-02-24 - Diego Martinez: Implemented prototype in runtime-branch 'flow-stratify'. Added two new metrics: kv_occupancy_p90 and gpu_reserved_headroom_bytes. Initial synthetic replay (10k qps for 30m) shows 28% reduction in p99 latency and 12% throughput improvement compared to baseline with identical batching config.

2025-02-26 - Performance SIG review (notes): Positive on metric approach; concerns about config surface area and operator mental model. Suggested adding safe defaults and an auto-tuner that keeps sustained-pressure threshold conservative by default.

2025-02-28 - Diego Martinez: Pushed PR with feature flag (flow_stratify=true). Implementation details: admission calculates pressure_score = alpha*burst_signal + beta*sustained_signal where sustained_signal is derived from kv_occupancy_p75..p99 spread and gpu_reserved_headroom fraction. Admission actions: (a) defer microbatch aggregation for lower-priority requests, (b) preemptively spill non-hot KV entries when sustained_signal>0.8 (configurable).

2025-03-01 - UX/Console feedback (from Priya Shah): Need observability surface: per-route pressure_score timeline, current stratification state, and recommended knob values. Added dashboard ticket to console backlog.

2025-03-03 - Experiment notes: Ran canary across 3 regions for a week against high-concurrency workload (customer X). Observed: 45% fewer KV evictions during sustained load, tail latency improved p99 40% in worst region; however some low-priority background requests saw increased latency by ~30% — acceptable but flagged for SLA consideration.

2025-03-04 - Next steps (Diego): (1) Add conservative auto-tuner to adjust alpha/beta by measuring immediate post-admission delta on p95/p99; (2) Add developer docs and runbook (Confluence link); (3) Wire console metrics and safe default profiles: 'latency-first', 'throughput-first', 'balanced'.
